summary: Source macOS Orchestra recovery binds exact solve/branch checkpoint invocations and native TaskIR receipts to recursively selected source paths. Controlled application restarts reject equal-valued source switches and preserve unused-alternative independence; two actual Agent/BEAM restart rounds retain unchanged routes. This is bounded contract/recovery evidence, not authenticated data provenance, general durable continuation, independent numerical accuracy, scale or operational qualification.

required_text: Each artifact retains one ephemeral path digest, not its ancestors or value.
recursive path binding distinguishes sources behind the same join output
unused paths and publication order do not change the selected binding
equal payload from a changed fallback source blocks solve reuse
unused failed alternative may change without invalidating the same fallback
equal inputs cannot reuse a solve with changed or previously unbound provenance
equal inputs cannot reuse a decision with changed or previously unbound provenance
identical payloads from a changed consumed path cannot adopt an original receipt
Source switches are tested with a controlled typed-solve client
